subject: Draft MAP: Data handling & retention checkpoints — BetaHealth
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@betahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Draft MAP: Data handling & retention checkpoints — BetaHealth

Hi Emily,

Thanks again for the time today — appreciated the detailed walk-through of BetaHealth's ingestion flow and audit requirements. Per our call, I captured an initial set of MAP milestones focused on data handling, retention, and logging so we can align on owners and the target close date. The attached workbook has a tab for each milestone and a brief acceptance criteria column.

High level summary (attached: BetaHealth_MAP_v1.xlsx):
- Milestone 1 — Retention policy & configuration: define retention windows for PHI/PII-derived artifacts, config location, and enforcement knobs. Owner: BetaHealth / Implementation.
- Milestone 2 — Audit logging & immutable trails: ensure request/response logging meets your internal audit format (timestamped, ID-correlated). Owner: Redwood infra + BetaHealth compliance.
- Milestone 3 — PHI/PII scoping & controls: catalog data types that will be allowed through hosted vs private deployments; recommend guardrails. Owner: BetaHealth Data Privacy lead.
- Milestone 4 — Evidence pack for security review: SOC2 summary, logging retention proof, and sample export for audit. Owner: Redwood Security.

Target close date for the MAP: 2027-01-15 (we discussed shipping the first validation in early January). Dependencies we called out: final list of endpoints and sample payloads, KMS integration decision (customer KMS vs Redwood-managed), and whether BetaHealth requires on-prem connector for PHI use-cases.

Next steps I propose:
1) I will upload the MAP workbook with editable owner columns (attached).
2) Can you confirm BetaHealth owners for each row by EOD Thursday 12/04?
3) If procurement needs a separate timeline for the contract/procurement path, loop in procurement@betahealth.com and we'll mirror dates.

Attaching a short SOC2 excerpt for quick reference (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf). Happy to hop on a quick 20-minute sync if you want to run through the milestones in more detail.

Regards,

--
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments:
- BetaHealth_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)
- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (pdf)
From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@betahealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <carlos.ruiz@betahealth.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T12:38:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: Data handling & retention checkpoints — BetaHealth

Karthik — thanks for sending this through and for the clear recap. Quick notes from our side after internal sync: 

- High level approve the milestones; we will own the PHI scoping (Milestone 3) and confirm owners by end of day 12/04 as you requested.
- For Milestone 2 (Audit logging), we need to confirm that Redwood's logging capture includes request IDs, user identifiers (hashed), and sequence numbers — Carlos will work with your engineering contacts to validate a sample export.
- KMS: BetaHealth prefers customer-managed KMS for any PHI workloads. We need to know if Redwood's Private deployment supports an HSM-backed KMS in our VPC (and a short runbook).

Procurement: I've included procurement@betahealth.com in case there are timeline constraints for the commercial terms.

We will review the SOC2 summary and get back with any clarifying Qs. Can you also send a short example of the logging schema (field names) so our security architect can do a gap analysis?

Thanks — Emily

--
Emily Chen
Director, Product Security | BetaHealth
emily.chen@betahealth.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@betahealth.com>, procurement@betahealth.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Carlos Ruiz <carlos.ruiz@betahealth.com>
Date: 2026-12-03T08:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: Data handling & retention checkpoints — BetaHealth

Emily / Carlos / procurement team —

Appreciate the quick confirmation. Per Carlos' ask, attaching a lightweight logging schema example and a short runbook note on the Private deployment KMS options. I'll drop the runbook into the shared Drive folder and add a README with the HSM integration checklist.

Summary of the updates I made in the MAP workbook (BetaHealth_MAP_v1.xlsx):
- Added a column "logging_schema_example" with a link placeholder to the sample export (see Drive link in MAP).
- Updated Milestone owners column for Redwood to include Stephanie for the audit evidence pack and Monica for implementation coordination.
- Noted KMS preference: customer-managed KMS required for PHI workloads — flagged as a blocking dependency and added an "KMS decision" checkpoint with target 12/10.

Proposed updated timeline:
- 12/04: BetaHealth confirms owners and provides sample payloads.
- 12/10: KMS decision / runbook acceptance.
- 12/20: Logging sample validation complete.
- 01/10: Internal validation (end-to-end) and evidence collection.
- 01/15: MAP acceptance / target close.

Carlos — can you confirm who on your side will own the sample payloads and the security architect contact? If you'd prefer, we can run a focused 30-minute logging validation on 12/11.

Best,

--
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
